relationships.evidence_text: appeared in the 1782 Little Creek Hundred taxables. It is 		believed he moved to New Jersey around 1809 when he married Margaret Teel in 			Salem on 14 September 1809.

, John Francisco was originally a slave, owned by Stephen Charlton, of Nassawaddox Creek, VA. Charlton was a devout Anglican with a rather ambivalent feeling about slavery. He was a Justice of the Pea
